_doc: Canonical transition + easing vocabulary. Read by both engines and montage_mode.py. See docs/design/transitions.md. Durations are in seconds; 0 or negative renders as `cut`. Do not add a type without a mapping for every side that can render it (reel-canvas, Remotion, ffmpeg xfade) or an explicit null.

cut.note: no interpolation; montage emits a plain concat

dissolve.note: cross-fade opacity; native on every side

rect-morph.note: the current vrect x/y/w/h/r lerp between stage rects; no montage equivalent

wipe.note: hard edge sweeps across; xfade: wipeup/wipedown/wipeleft/wiperight

push.note: old and new both translate; xfade: slideup/slidedown/slideleft/slideright

zoom-blur.note: scale up + blur out then in; xfade zoomin is a loose approximation

iris.note: radial reveal; dir open|close -> xfade circleopen/circleclose

glitch.note: the current RGB-split slice effect; xfade pixelize is a loose approximation

rise.note: fade + translateY(y->0) + optional out-back scale. This is exactly what caption enter does today (y=28, scale=true) and caption exit reversed (y=-10, scale=false, easing linear).
